tau_zero_explanation: Under tau=0.0, diff_max >= tau (0.0 >= 0.0) is True, so no tokens are dropped (rate=1.0). Under any positive tau > 0 (e.g. tau=0.02), identical frames satisfy diff < tau and are merged, yielding the exact theoretical lower bound of 1/8 (12.5%).

eq10_consistency.design_s3_usage: R-arm applies Eq 10 to tubelet-2 tokens (chunks of 2 frames), so p_t is tubelet t.
eq10_consistency.accumulated_drift_note: Because Eq 10 and rlt.py use Markovian (p_{t-1}) rather than anchor-based comparison, slowly drifting background or camera pan can accumulate reconstruction errors exceeding tau.
